changes.before:
Every change of the software is reviewed by a second person before it is released.

* Dependencies are checked for known vulnerabilities at every build.
* Secrets are never stored in the source code.
changes.after:
Every change of the software is reviewed by a second person before it is released.

* Dependencies are checked for known vulnerabilities at every build and every week.
* Secrets are never stored in the source code; a secret that was committed is replaced at once.
* A threat model exists for every service with a very high protection need.
